messages.subject: Amended Particulars - redline for sign-off (recall now 286 units)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, James,

Attached is the redline of the Particulars reflecting Harriet's amendments. The main change is the recall - it's grown from 214 to 286 units as more came back, so the rework head goes from £512,400 to £648,900 and the total from £1,421,650 to £1,558,150. Figures tie to the revised schedule of loss.

If you're happy I'll get the clean amended version finalised for issue.

Tom
